title: Recuperative potential of nano-biochar to alleviate arsenic toxicity in soybean (Glycine max): modulation of uptake, morphological and biochemical properties
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00227C, Paper
Mohammad Faisal, Aynur Bilmez Özçinar, Mohammad Faizan, Haider Sultan, Yawar Habib, Abdulrahman A. Alatar, Ranjith Pathirana
Nano-biochar (1% w/w) effectively mitigated arsenic toxicity in soybean by improving growth, reducing oxidative stress, and enhancing antioxidant responses, enhancing crop resilience.
